contentAdminUi.title: Articles
contentAdminUi.subtitleDoctor: Write articles and share videos for patients. An admin reviews each one before it goes public.
contentAdminUi.subtitleAdmin: Review and publish articles and videos written by practitioners.
contentAdminUi.loadFailed: Could not load articles. Please try again.
contentAdminUi.emptyAll: You have not written anything yet.

guidance.title: Before you submit
guidance.noDosing: Do not give doses or promise cures. Describe, do not prescribe.
guidance.evidence: Choose an evidence label that honestly matches what you wrote.
guidance.review: A reviewer will check it before it is published, and may send it back with a note.

contentAdminUi.readOnlyInReview: This article is waiting for review and cannot be edited. An admin can return it to you.
contentAdminUi.readOnlyPublished: This article is published and cannot be edited.

fields.title: Title
fields.summaryHint: One or two sentences shown in lists and search results.
fields.youtubeHint: Paste a link from YouTube. Only YouTube videos are supported.
fields.youtubeInvalid: This does not look like a YouTube link.
fields.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, like my-article-title. Left empty, it is made from the title.

evidenceMeaning.general_info: General health information; it does not make claims about treating any condition.
evidenceMeaning.traditional_use: Based on traditional practice; not tested to the standard of conventional medicine.
evidenceMeaning.limited_evidence: Some early research exists, but it is limited and not conclusive.
evidenceMeaning.studied: Has been studied in clinical research; the article links to or names that research.

contentAdminUi.oneLanguageEnough: Write in at least one language. Add the other when you can.
contentAdminUi.confirmDelete: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.

publishDialog.title: Publish article
publishDialog.description: The reviewer credit is shown publicly with the article.
publishDialog.reviewerHint: Name and qualification, for example Dr. A. Rahman, BHMS.
publishDialog.dueAtHint: If empty, it is set to one year from today.

returnDialog.title: Return to author
returnDialog.description: The article goes back to draft and the author sees your note.
